lastCompletedStory.title: Add best-effort auto-merge step to cam-ship.md (markdown + template + embed)

nextStoryContext: US-002 needs to define a shared AUTOMERGE_NOTICE constant (likely in src/logging/notices.ts or src/logging/color.ts) and print it unconditionally at cam init completion via an injectable-write-fn helper. US-003 then imports the same constant into config.ts. US-004 adds a runbook scenario (s). The notice text should match the phrasing in cam-ship.md Step 7's best-effort echo: 'Allow auto-merge' and 'Allow squash merging' in Settings > General > Pull Requests.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: --auto enables auto-merge once requirements are met; --squash squashes commits; without a PR number it detects the current branch's PR automatically. Failure when 'Allow auto-merge' is disabled in repo settings is not documented (empirical: exits non-zero with a GraphQL enablePullRequestAutoMerge error). Implementation matches docs.
